_meta.description: Everything Pano Owl does: guided 48 MP and ProRAW capture, planar, cylindrical and 360° stitching with no resolution cap, HDR, auto-crop, Shortcuts and an immersive viewer.
a-live-meter-shows.2a8121: A live meter shows how much you move during each shot, and drops the frame if you drift, so soft frames never make it into the stitch.
a-tiled-out-of.71fc17: A tiled, out-of-core engine means resolution isn't capped by your device's memory. Gigapixel scenes, on a phone.
an-out-of-core.b8f0d4: An out-of-core tiled engine stitches huge, high-resolution panoramas that wouldn't fit in memory — RAM stays bounded no matter how big the panorama gets. No more downscaling to make it fit.
auto-crop-finds-the.75ff6a: Auto-crop finds the largest clean rectangle in your panorama, so there are no black edges.
capture-now-stitch-later.cdd42f: Capture now, stitch later. Your location and compass heading ride along with every shot.
capture-saves-gps-altitude.96817e: Capture saves GPS, altitude, and compass heading with your panorama, written as standard metadata so web and Vision Pro viewers orient it correctly.
capture-stitch-perfect-and.c76dec: Capture, stitch, perfect and step inside your panoramas, all on your iPhone or iPad. One purchase includes everything.
choose-planar-cylindrical-or.622212: Choose planar, cylindrical, or true 360° spherical. Pano Owl matches features across any number of frames, warps them on the GPU, and blends a seamless result — preserving the detail of your originals.
drop-in-a-mixed.c46238: Drop in a mixed pile of photos and Pano Owl detects and stitches each separate panorama on its own — no need to sort your shots first.
every-export-carries-gpano.8f8266: Every export carries GPano metadata, so the same file looks right in web viewers, the Photos app, and on Apple Vision Pro.
finished-a-sphere-look.943628: Finished a sphere? Look around it immersively in the app — drag or move your device to glance in any direction. Open existing panoramas from your library to relive them in 360.
fuse-exposure-brackets-into.d16ce0: Fuse exposure brackets into one perfectly exposed image, and keep moving objects from doubling into ghosts at the seams. Reliable blends, even in tricky light.
look-around-your-panoramas.e510ed: Look around your panoramas right in the app — drag, or move your device to glance around the scene. Open any panorama from your photo library and step inside it.
mount-the-phone-on.1a5cfa: Mount the phone on your DSLR or mirrorless camera and it draws a grid sized to that lens and sensor while you fire the real camera.
mount-your-phone-follow.ab3968: Mount your phone, follow the on-screen targets, and Pano Owl fires each frame the moment you're on point — sized to your lens, with the right overlap. Blurry frame? It catches it and asks for a re-take, right there.
no-tracking-no-ads.5e7933: No tracking. No ads. Your panoramas are stitched right on your device.
on-screen-motion-guidance.492deb: On-screen motion guidance walks you through every frame and auto-captures when you're on target. Use any lens — including telephoto — and on-device blur detection flags soft shots to re-take on the spot.
planar-cylindrical-and-real.067afd: Planar, cylindrical, and real spherical (equirectangular) projections. Partial arcs to full 360 — stitch whatever you shoot. Exports carry standard GPano metadata so they render correctly in web viewers, Photos, and on Apple Vision Pro.
shoot-at-the-full.be068d: Shoot at the full 48 MP of your camera, or 24 or 12 MP, and keep true sensor data for every frame with Apple ProRAW.
slide-along-a-wall.1c83cd: Slide along a wall, a page or a ceiling for a flat mosaic. Pano Owl works out whether you pivoted or slid, or you can tell it.
stitch-straight-from-the.355c56: Stitch straight from the Shortcuts app: photos in, a finished panorama out, with your projection, export and crop settings.
straighten-the-horizon-drag.f45b01: Straighten the horizon, drag the corners to fix distortion, and fine-tune the crop. Turn a video into a panorama — Pano Owl extracts the cleanest frames for you.
